fixer.title: Canvases: Avoid redundant Editor Canvas menu refreshes

introducer.title: Canvases: UI for opening Canvases from Editor Window

cases.mechanism: Every canvas membership publication or subscription snapshot that returned content-identical definitions produced a fresh array, invalidated the observable, rescanned the full definitions/targets collections, and replaced the Canvas submenu registration, causing redundant MenuRegistry notifications and observer rebuilds.
cases.symptom: Unchanged canvas refreshes caused avoidable menu refresh notifications and synchronous collection-wide menu reconciliation in the renderer.
cases.fixedBehavior: The changed observable uses structuralEquals, so an unchanged flat definition catalog is rejected at set time. The catalog RPC still occurs, but collection-wide menu reconciliation, submenu disposal/recreation, MenuRegistry notifications, and dependent menu rebuilds are skipped unless catalog content changes.
cases.evidence: The base observable used strict reference equality, while loadAvailableDefinitions always creates a fresh filtered/sorted array after listCanvases. Canvas definition notifications are emitted for ChatCanvasesChanged actions and snapshots, so an unchanged catalog still reran the definitions/targets autorun. That autorun scans all definitions and targets and always replaces submenuRegistration; MutableDisposable disposes the old MenuRegistry item and appends a new one, and both operations fire MenuRegistry change events that schedule menu refreshes. The added test explicitly fires an unchanged definition refresh and proves the submenu object is now retained.
